caves.name: head_camera_epilogue_cave

caves.name: head_camera_cast_cave

caves.name: head_camera_manager_cave
caves.purpose: Camera-manager cave: touchpad double-click toggle of MODE (libScePad report ring), mode-dependent FOV (copies FPSFOV/TPFOV into the Wide-FOV constant every frame), validated pointer walk, holder/slot search, 30 Hz latch + smoothing, height floor, close-character guard, death camera (HP <= 0: no floor, view rows from the head bone, DFLOOR), distance guard, head position replaces the position row, then the AIM block re-orients to the lock-on target. Subroutines H (holder, optionally hosted by A = [mod+0x10]) and P (array plausibility) are inside. 3847 bytes: written as four cheat entries (3 x 1000 + 847 bytes) because onionHEN's entries are limited to 1024 bytes (ONION_MAX_PATCH_BYTES); see docs/agents/70-onionhen-cheat-engine.md hazard 1.

fields.initialised_by: runtime (zero at start)

fields.name: NOCOLL
fields.description: 1 = camera collision casts return 'no hit'. Entry on=01 off=00 in the core mod.
fields.initialised_by: head camera core mod entry (on 01 / off 00)

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: 1 = camera-manager position override active. Written LAST when applying (switches the mod on). Toggled by the touchpad double click.
fields.initialised_by: head camera core mod entry (on 01 / off 00), last entry

fields.name: AIM
fields.description: 1 = re-aim at the lock-on target (needs MODE). Own cheat mod.
fields.initialised_by: AIM mod (on 01 / off 00)

fields.name: FACE2
fields.description: 1 = rotate displayed model rows to face the camera (hides coat/hood cloth). Own cheat mod.
fields.initialised_by: FACE2 mod (on 01 / off 00)

fields.name: DEADF
fields.description: Death flag: 1 while HP [[pl+0x3b0]+0x20]+0xf8 <= 0 (recomputed every frame by the manager cave while the head camera is on); lifts the height floor, switches on the death-camera rows, suspends FACE2.
fields.initialised_by: cave-owned runtime state (zero at start, not in any cheat entry)

fields.name: SLOWON
fields.description: 1 = death slow motion on (own cheat mod 'FPS head camera: death slow motion'); the hook at 0x1E196BB belongs to that mod.
fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod (on 01 / off 00)

fields.name: PADTOG
fields.description: Enables the touchpad double-click toggle of MODE. Entry on=01 off=00 in the core mod.
fields.initialised_by: head camera core mod entry (on 01 / off 00)

fields.name: PADPREV
fields.description: Previous touchpad button state (edge detection).
fields.initialised_by: runtime (zero at start)

fields.name: FRAME
fields.description: Frame counter incremented by the pad code on every run with a valid libScePad layout.
fields.initialised_by: runtime (zero at start)

fields.name: PADLAST
fields.description: FRAME value of the last rising edge; a second click within 30 frames (about 0.5 s) toggles MODE and clears this to 0.
fields.initialised_by: runtime (zero at start)

fields.name: FALLV

fields.name: AIMMIN2

fields.name: GAMMA

fields.name: SIGNZ

fields.name: SIGNALL

fields.name: TU

fields.initialised_by: runtime (zero at start)

fields.name: DECAY
fields.description: Per-frame multiplier of TR/TU while the user turns the camera (0.97).
fields.initialised_by: cheat entry at 0x54A0F30

fields.name: MOTCOS

fields.initialised_by: cheat entry at 0x54A0F30

fields.name: TINY
fields.description: TR^2+TU^2 below this = no aim offset.
fields.initialised_by: cheat entry at 0x54A0F30

fields.name: FPSFOV

fields.name: TPFOV

fields.name: DEPS

fields.name: HA

fields.name: FS

fields.name: US

fields.initialised_by: cave-owned runtime state (zero at start, not in any cheat entry)

fields.name: DFLR
fields.description: origin.y + DFLOOR for this frame (computed before the origin register is reused).
fields.initialised_by: cave-owned runtime state (zero at start, not in any cheat entry)

fields.name: TSCALE

fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F78 (16 bytes: TSCALE, PH1SCALE, PH1END, SLOWG)

fields.name: PH1SCALE
fields.description: Time scale of phase 1 (the first PH1END manager frames after the death). Default 1.0: the death animation and the YOU DIED screen run at normal speed.
fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F78 (16 bytes: TSCALE, PH1SCALE, PH1END, SLOWG)

fields.name: PH1END

fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F78 (16 bytes: TSCALE, PH1SCALE, PH1END, SLOWG)

fields.name: SLOWG

fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F78 (16 bytes: TSCALE, PH1SCALE, PH1END, SLOWG)

fields.name: DCNT

fields.initialised_by: cave-owned runtime state (zero at start, not in any cheat entry)

fields.name: PH2SCALE
fields.description: Time scale of phase 2 (slow motion after the YOU DIED screen has arrived).
fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F8C (8 bytes: PH2SCALE, PH2END)

fields.name: PH2END
fields.description: Frames after the death at which the time scale returns to 1.0 (12 s).
fields.initialised_by: death slow motion mod: cheat entry at 0x54A0F8C (8 bytes: PH2SCALE, PH2END)
